fields.subject: Copy Load
fields.trigger: the COPY row-writer delegate for a model type is compiled on first use of that type
fields.response: when the host logger has Debug enabled, render the compiled expression tree as a debug-view listing and log it with the model type through CreatedExpressionTreeForCopy at Debug under event id ExpressionTreeCreation (1), with a message saying the model is mapped to Pg COPY row values; and embed into the compiled writer a TraceCopyMapperProperty call per mapped property, so that every row written emits a Trace-level event under event id MapperProcessTrace (5) naming each property as it is written
fields.postcondition: with Debug disabled no rendering occurs
